# Cully v0.9.1

Docs and CI maintenance on top of v0.9.0's port selection.

- The docs introduction now describes Cully as a companion for better work and everyday life, not only session resume and guidance.
- CI runs one end-to-end check that follows the documented path: install, `cully setup`, MCP use and uninstall. It replaces the separate compose-only job.

There are no CLI or stack changes. Ports, OAuth and setup behave as in v0.9.0.
